newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy says PSBR 42 trln lire through April '97.
newsitem.headline: Italy says PSBR 42 trln lire through April '97.

text.p: Italy's cumulative public sector borrowing requirement was around 42 trillion lire at end-April 1997, compared with 71.673 trillion in the first four months of last year, the Treasury said on Friday.
It said in a statement the borrowing requirement in April was around 18 trillion lire, more than 7.3 trillion less than in April 1996.
The statement gave no further data but said the figures were worked out in accordance with a ruling in March by Eurostat, the EU's statistics body. -- Rome newsroom +396 678 2501
